title: Differential Expression and Target Gene Analysis of PBMC-Derived microRNAs as Prognostic Biomarkers in Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
Differential Expression and Target Gene Analysis of PBMC-Derived microRNAs as Prognostic Biomarkers in Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia-Abstract

paragraphs.origin_text: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) is a clinically diverse cancer in which microRNA (miRNA)-mediated post-transcriptional regulation contributes to leukemogenesis and subtype heterogeneity. In this study, miRNA expression profiling by microarray was performed on ALL cases (B-ALL and T-ALL) and healthy controls. Data were normalized and analyzed for differential expression using false discovery rate (FDR)-adjusted
